title: EFSPI_Events_Calendar
text:
This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.


This is a Quarto website that renders an EFSPI (European Federation of Statisticians in the Pharmaceutical Industry) events calendar. It reads event data from an Excel file and displays it as a formatted HTML table with hyperlinks, then publishes to GitHub Pages.



Render the site (from RStudio or terminal with Quarto installed):
quarto render
Preview locally with live reload:
quarto preview
The rendered output goes to docs/ (configured in _quarto.yml), which is the GitHub Pages source directory.




Events.xlsx — the sole data source; contains columns Date, Agenda Link, and Registration Link (and likely event name/description). Edit this file to add/update events.
index.qmd — the main page; reads Events.xlsx via readxl, formats it with flextable, and renders hyperlinked “Agenda” and “Registration” columns.
_quarto.yml — site config: output dir is docs/, theme is cosmo, navbar includes Home and an about.qmd page.
docs/ — rendered HTML output committed to the repo for GitHub Pages hosting. Always re-render and commit docs/ after changing Events.xlsx or index.qmd.




The R code in index.qmd requires: tidyverse, flextable, readxl. These must be installed in the R environment before rendering.




Edit Events.xlsx with new event rows.
Run quarto render to regenerate docs/.
Commit both Events.xlsx and the updated docs/ contents.





about.qmd is referenced in the navbar but is not present in the repo — it will cause a render warning/error if missing. Create it if the about page is needed.
_site/ is a local Quarto preview directory; docs/ is the authoritative output for GitHub Pages.
